dataIdInfo.idAbs: Administrative boundaries (Level 2 - Counties including disputed Abyei region) Digitised from Russian Topo maps 200k (1970)

Consts.useLimit: See the COD/FOD Registry Terms of Use. This does not replace any terms of use information provided with the dataset.

dataLineage.statement:
Layer was downloaded as a shapefile by ITOS from the UNOCHA COD FOD Registry. It was then analyzed by ITOS for errors. Those errors were corrected and then the layer was sent back to UNOCHA as a feature class within a file geodatabase.
The following errors were corrected: 1. Reference name field was created and populated 2. Fixed 1 gap error between Juba and Mundri East
The following errors were found by ITOS and left as is: 1. The Admin1 layer does not contain the disuputed Abyei region and the Admin2 layer does so the two layers do not nest.
